notes: Fix: User Management and Personnel File no longer go blank on installs without the Forms module; Personnel File only shows tabs for the modules installed.
Sandbox: System › Demo modules switches any module on or off (add-ons included) for a demo; the sandbox download now carries every module.
Linux installer: --local tries a customer's system on one computer (Ubuntu on Windows): https://localhost with its own certificate, no web address needed.

Retail modules (only when a license names them; never on St. George's install): Live Spot Prices (ticker on every page, today/week/month charts, Your Day card, showroom TV view) and Quick Links (team websites; shared logins encrypted and shown only to chosen people, every view logged; personal logins only their owner can see).
Database update 053 (spot price history, Quick Links).
Business installs don't show the Fire / Comms shift chips.

New customer setup: a customer kit from the License Manager installs a server already named, licensed and branded (Linux installer --kit), and the customer's first admin gets a short setup wizard (name, logo, colors, menu names).

Branding page (User Management › System, Fenmorix OS installs only): organization name, logo (the app icon, browser tab icon and watermark are made from it), colors with a live preview, and menu names. Saved outside the app folder so updates keep it.
Wording: page text and messages use the product's own name (St. George still reads Nexus).
Fenmorix Technologies' license signing key is built in, so signed customer licenses work on real servers.
Fix: installs in a folder whose name has a space.
Backups also keep the branding and license folders.
St. George (SGFD Nexus): no visible changes.
